Topic 2.2: Phonic awareness (k-r)
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Phonic awareness (k-r), part of Reading 2.1 Visual memory (3 Lessons) By the end of the sub strand the learner s in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP1 General.

Key inquiry question: Which things have sound ‘b’ in their name?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Phonic awareness (k-r) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
● Love is developed as the learner chant rhymes together on letter sounds.

● Unity is enhanced as the learners work together in chanting letter sounds while competing on who to shout with the highest

voice.

58

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
● Citizenship is enhanced as the learner begins to appreciate things found in their neighbourhood.

● Effective communication as a life skill is enhanced as the learners learn about sounds, chant rhymes on sounds and relate the

sounds to corresponding objects.

Link to other Learning Areas: Mathematics as the learner matches sound.

Suggested learning resources: Charts, board, books, cards and labels to enhance letter recognition.
